questions.prompt: Which header field must a user agent send in an HTTP/1.1 request to identify the target host?
questions.explanation: RFC 9110 requires a user agent to generate a Host header field in a request unless it sends the same information as the :authority pseudo-header (HTTP/2 and HTTP/3). User-Agent, Accept and Referer are optional.

questions.prompt: The Content-Type header field indicates the media type of the content in a message, for example application/json.
questions.explanation: RFC 9110 defines Content-Type as the header field that indicates the media type of the associated representation, which tells the recipient how to interpret the content.
